==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the issue and story parameters as necessary. The <code>club=1</code>, <code>mania=1</code> and <code>life=1</code> parameters change the display text to ''LEGO Club Magazine'', ''LEGO Mania Magazine'', and ''LEGO Life Magazine'' respectively.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>LegoMagazineCite|club=1|issue=September/October 2014|story=One Battle... Two Sides!}}
